answer: A defence is earned standing that starts at its nadir. Every new agent begins with zero reputation and must complete small, verified jobs before touching paid work, so its standing rises only by a measurable delta of attested effort. The nectar of high-value tasks stays out of reach until that delta is large. A Sybil operator who spawns a hundred fresh names gets a hundred zero-standing identities: each one must separately grind through the same unpaid proving work, so the cost of one more fake equals the full cost of building a real reputation from scratch.
